attempts.summary: Configured centralized logging: node2 runs a simulated 'inventory' app (OpenRC service) that logs via syslog; rsyslog on node2 forwards those messages (disk-queued, infinite retry) to node1 over TCP 514; rsyslog on node1 receives and persists them to /var/log/inventory/node2.log. Verified live delivery, then restarted node1 and node2 sequentially (boot_id changed for both), confirming rsyslog/inventory services auto-start at boot, previously persisted log data survives, and log flow resumes/queued messages flush after each restart.
